visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt with 'suede' text, sits on a wooden floor in a dimly lit room. In front of her is a large brown cardboard box labeled 'Artemide'. She gestures towards the box with her hands while smiling and looking at someone off-camera. (2) The woman uses a small utility knife to cut the tape on the box. An inset circle appears in the lower left corner showing a close-up of another woman's face. The background includes a black record cabinet and a green poster. (3) She pulls out a large object wrapped in white bubble wrap. Her facial expressions are highly animated, showing wide-eyed surprise and a big smile. She vigorously shakes the wrapped object before starting to peel away the plastic layers. (4) The woman unveils a bright orange, mushroom-shaped lamp. She holds it up with both hands to show the glossy texture and sleek design. The lighting is warm, emphasizing the vibrant orange color of the plastic object against the neutral room background. (5) She places the lamp on the floor and picks up a white power cord with a switch. She carefully inspects the plug and looks back into the empty box for additional parts. Her movements are deliberate and focused on the new item. (6) The lamp is now illuminated, casting a warm yellow glow onto the woman's face and the surrounding floor. She is seated next to it, admiring the light and touching the smooth top of the lampshade with her right hand. (7) She continues talking to the camera, gesturing towards the glowing lamp. Her expression is one of contentment and pride. The camera remains at a low angle, focusing on her and the product in the cozy indoor setting. (8) In the final moments, she smiles broadly and waves her hands. Large white text overlays appear on the screen, framing her as she concludes the unboxing. The lamp remains lit in the foreground, serving as the central visual focus.

(2) A sharp slicing sound occurs as the cardboard box is opened, followed immediately by high-frequency plastic rustling. (3) The main speaker exclaims 'Oh my god' with significant vocal arousal and positive valence. Laughter from a second female is clearly audible in the background mix. (4) A mechanical 'click' sound triggers as the lamp's power switch is flipped. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo around 105 BPM. (5) Sounds of soft thuds and hand-on-plastic friction are heard as the lamp is adjusted on the floor. The speech remains dense and fast-paced. (6) The video ends with a synchronized swell in music volume and a final humorous remark delivered with a friendly, casual tone.

The intent is to showcase the product's aesthetic appeal, discuss its value/price, and share a positive, consumerist lifestyle moment with the audience.
